API docs by Redocly

Starburst Workloads (v1)

Download OpenAPI specification:

About

APIs to manage batch jobs, connect servers, notebook servers and their runs

⬇️ Download OpenAPI specification

Roles

All APIs support the standard Trino role header of X-Trino-Role. Set a role for the API request by setting the header to system=ROLE{role-name}.

Uploads

The combined size of an uploaded set of text files, binary files, or secrets cannot exceed 10MB and each individual file or secret cannot exceed 1MB.

Namespaces

Each API namespace is versioned independently and has its own reference document.

Browse all API namespaces

cloneJob

Clone an existing job into a new job. Any value not set in the request is inherited from the source job.

Authorizations:
None
path Parameters
jobId
required
string

Job details

Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string

The name of the cloned job

resourcePool
string

The resource pool ID or name to use (you must have permission to use it). If omitted, the source job's resource pool is inherited.

instanceImageId
string

Instance image id to use (you must have permission to use it). If omitted, the source job's image is inherited.

description
string

The description of the cloned job. Pass an empty string to clear it; if omitted, the source job's description is inherited.

Array of objects (VolumeMount)

Standalone volumes to mount to the job. If omitted, the source job's mounts are inherited. (read only)

object (InlineVolumeMount)

Inline volume to attach to the job. If omitted, the source job's inline upload is inherited. (read only)

mainClass
string

The main class of the batch job. Pass an empty string to clear it; if omitted, the source job's main class is inherited.

object (SparkApplication)

The application resource to run - a URI on an accessible object store, or a file in the inline upload. If omitted, the source job's application is inherited.

applicationArguments
Array of strings

Any application arguments. If omitted, the source job's arguments are inherited.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished
integer <int32>

ttlSecondsAfterFinished specifies the number of seconds after completion that the driver is eligible to be deleted/cleaned. Pass 0 to clear it; if omitted, the source job's value is inherited.

object (SparkJobRestartSettings)

Restart settings. If provided, the job will be retried on failure up to maxRetries times; pass maxRetries 0 to clear it. If omitted, the source job's restart settings are inherited.

object

Any Spark configuration/properties to set arguments

Array of objects

Any jars to pass in the --jars Spark argument

Array of objects

Any python files to pass in the --py-files Spark argument

Array of objects

Any files to pass in the --files Spark argument

Array of objects

Any archives to pass in the --archives Spark argument

object

Any environment variables to set

options
Array of strings

Options:

kind
required
string

Responses

/workloads/api/v1/job/{jobId}:clone

cloneJobUpload

Clone an inline upload mounted by the job into a new, mutable upload. Used both when editing a job's uploaded files and when cloning a job: the immutable source upload is cloned so that files can be removed from or added to the copy without affecting the original.

Authorizations:
None
path Parameters
jobId
required
string

Job details

Request Body schema: application/json
required
configurationId
required
string

The id of the configuration whose inline upload will be cloned. The configuration must have an inline upload.

name
required
string

Name for the cloned upload. Must be unique in the system.

description
string

Optional description for the cloned upload. Defaults to the source upload's description.

Responses

/workloads/api/v1/job/{jobId}/upload:clone

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json

  • "configurationId": "string",
  • "name": "string",
  • "description": "string"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 403
  • 409
Content type
application/json
{
  • "uploadId": "string",
  • "name": "string"
}

listJob

List of jobs for the user

Authorizations:
None
query Parameters
kind
Array of strings

Filter by job kinds; repeat the parameter to match any of: ADHOC, RECURRING, SCHEDULED

name
string

Filter by fuzzy word similarity of the job name

id
string

Filter by exact job id

status
Array of strings

Filter by job statuses; repeat the parameter to match any of: ACTIVE, INACTIVE

lastRunStatus
Array of strings

Filter by last run statuses; repeat the parameter to match any of: RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, UNKNOWN, PENDING, AWAITING_RESOURCES, SCHEDULING, TERMINATED, SKIPPED

createdBy
Array of strings

Filter by submitters; repeat the parameter to match any submitter

resourcePoolId
Array of strings

Filter by resource pool ids; repeat the parameter to match any pool

createdFrom
string

Created lower limit (inclusive)

createdTo
string

Created upper limit (inclusive)

lastRunFrom
string

Last run lower limit (inclusive)

lastRunTo
string

Last run upper limit (inclusive)

nextRunFrom
string

Next run lower limit (inclusive)

nextRunTo
string

Next run upper limit (inclusive)

orderBy
string
Enum: "createdAt" "id" "nameSimilarity"

Sort/ordering in standard SQL ORDER BY format. Allowed values: createdAt, id, nameSimilarity

pageToken
string

Pagination token

pageSize
integer <int32>

Page size or 0 for default (current maximum is 100)

Responses

/workloads/api/v1/job

createJob

Create a new job (adhoc job, scheduled job, recurring job)

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
string

Optional - the job name. If not provided a name will be generated.

resourcePool
required
string

The resource pool ID or name to use (you must have permission to use it)

instanceImageId
string

Instance image id to use (you must have permission to use it)

description
string

Optional - the description of the job

Array of objects (VolumeMount)

Optional - standalone volumes to mount to the job (read only)

object (InlineVolumeMount)

Inline volume to attach to the job. If omitted, the source job's inline upload is inherited. (read only)

mainClass
string

The main class of the batch job

required
object (SparkApplication2)

The application resource to run - a URI on an accessible object store, or a file in the inline upload

applicationArguments
Array of strings

Any application arguments

ttlSecondsAfterFinished
integer <int32>

Optional.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished specifies the number of seconds after completion that the driver is eligible to be deleted/cleaned. Default is 3 seconds.

object (SparkJobRestartSettings)

Restart settings. If provided, the job will be retried on failure up to maxRetries times; pass maxRetries 0 to clear it. If omitted, the source job's restart settings are inherited.

object

Any Spark configuration/properties to set arguments

Array of objects

Any jars to pass in the --jars Spark argument

Array of objects

Any python files to pass in the --py-files Spark argument

Array of objects

Any files to pass in the --files Spark argument

Array of objects

Any archives to pass in the --archives Spark argument

object

Any environment variables to set

options
Array of strings

Options:

kind
required
string

Responses

/workloads/api/v1/job

Authorizations:
None
query Parameters
instanceId
string

Filter by instance id

kind
Array of strings

Filter by run kinds; repeat the parameter to match any of: ADHOC, RECURRING, SCHEDULED, CONNECT_SERVER, NOTEBOOK_SERVER

name
string

Filter by fuzzy word similarity of the run name

status
Array of strings

Filter by run statuses; repeat the parameter to match any of: RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, UNKNOWN, PENDING, AWAITING_RESOURCES, SCHEDULING, TERMINATED, SKIPPED

createdBy
Array of strings

Filter by submitters; repeat the parameter to match any submitter

resourcePoolId
Array of strings

Filter by resource pool ids; repeat the parameter to match any pool

createdFrom
string

Created lower limit (inclusive)

createdTo
string

Created upper limit (inclusive)

startedFrom
string

Started lower limit (inclusive)

startedTo
string

Started upper limit (inclusive)

finishedFrom
string

Finished lower limit (inclusive)

finishedTo
string

Finished upper limit (inclusive)

orderBy
string
Enum: "createdAt" "id"

Sort/ordering in standard SQL ORDER BY format. Allowed values: createdAt, id

pageToken
string

Pagination token

pageSize
integer <int32>

Page size or 0 for default (current maximum is 100)

JobCloneRequest

name
required
string

The name of the cloned job

resourcePool
string

The resource pool ID or name to use (you must have permission to use it). If omitted, the source job's resource pool is inherited.

instanceImageId
string

Instance image id to use (you must have permission to use it). If omitted, the source job's image is inherited.

description
string

The description of the cloned job. Pass an empty string to clear it; if omitted, the source job's description is inherited.

Array of objects (VolumeMount)

Standalone volumes to mount to the job. If omitted, the source job's mounts are inherited. (read only)

object (InlineVolumeMount)

Inline volume to attach to the job. If omitted, the source job's inline upload is inherited. (read only)

mainClass
string

The main class of the batch job. Pass an empty string to clear it; if omitted, the source job's main class is inherited.

object (SparkApplication)

The application resource to run - a URI on an accessible object store, or a file in the inline upload. If omitted, the source job's application is inherited.

applicationArguments
Array of strings

Any application arguments. If omitted, the source job's arguments are inherited.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished
integer <int32>

ttlSecondsAfterFinished specifies the number of seconds after completion that the driver is eligible to be deleted/cleaned. Pass 0 to clear it; if omitted, the source job's value is inherited.

object (SparkJobRestartSettings)

Restart settings. If provided, the job will be retried on failure up to maxRetries times; pass maxRetries 0 to clear it. If omitted, the source job's restart settings are inherited.

mainClass
string

The main class of the batch job. Pass an empty string to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.
